title: Canonical derived scalar Kummer Chern arrow
statement: For a ring A killed by N, a scheme T on which N is invertible, and a Picard class M, define its derived Chern arrow as the inverse of the proved ordinaryFiniteClass bijection applied to the scalar Kummer class. The bijection determines the arrow uniquely. Its ordinary class is the Kummer class; equality is detected by that class; tensor products give sums; and normalized pullback commutes with this arrow [lem-sp-ordinary-finite-class-arbitrary-base, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-kummer-class, def-asd-ordinary-finite-p1-arrows, lem-sp-ordinary-finite-chern-pullback].

source.place: Levelwise finite diagonal calculation, expanded in lem-sp-finite-p1-diagonal-kummer-component-formula

proof.text: Bundle the proved ordinaryFiniteClass bijection on the named degree-zero objects as ordinaryFiniteClassEquiv. Define the canonical Chern arrow by its inverse on the scalar Kummer class. Inverse cancellation proves the class formula; injectivity proves uniqueness. Additivity of the Ext equivalence, exact-functor map and Yoneda precomposition gives additivity of realization. Kummer additivity then gives the tensor-product formula. Apply scalar Chern pullback naturality and uniqueness to obtain the derived pullback equation.
